activity_units: Historical model notional inputs are summed token size. Report token size and price-times-size separately. Old cash diagnostic remains historical; no predictive eligibility from either.
api_migration_notice: Official documentation checked22Oct states legacy Data API retirement24Oct2026; replacement does not imply project v2 research cycle.
backoff: Endpoint bucket through response; 429 honors numeric/HTTP-date Retry-After with 60s floor. 401/403 blocks all REST buckets for >=3600s. No alternate route for blocked request.
cold_start: New receipt clock; no imports to fill history gaps; snapshot forecast needs current valid book/status only
control_rule: No controls enrolled in this two-market expansion run; earlier controls remain diagnostic only
dedup_rule: preserve raw prints; compare multiset normalized asset/second/price/size/side; never treat identical prints as proven unique transactions
dependencies: Quote service gates current book/status independently; original trade/news gates unchanged
gap_rule: journal/reconnect gaps unknown; REST backfill receives current availability and cannot restore timely capture
receipt_clocks: queued_at before scheduler; requested_at at actual dispatch; response_received_at; durable available_at; finished_at
rehearsal_criteria: Record all gaps and errors; completed wall time does not imply continuous capture
restart_rule: flock single process, validate append journal chain, same absolute deadline; a restart is a continuity gap
scope: 24h source capture for separate snapshot/30m-history midpoint forecasting; same two metadata-defined markets
scope_rule: exact market/token allowlists; reject unexpected response scopes before raw storage; no broad market streams
selection: Negative annual US GDP and dual-rule US recession; exact questions and rule spans, no prices or liquidity ranking
shutdown: Hard bounded run cancels queued requests and streams; cancellation is recorded separately from network failure
trade_windows: Venue v2 ignores market-window bounds: cursor through descending timestamps until below start or exhausted, then client-filter inclusive common window; cap/ordering failures unresolved. Provider window unchanged.
